title: feat(ui): New Package offers 「同时创建应用」 / Also create an app, ticked by default
body:
Fixes #37134
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在设置的「软件包」页点「新建软件包」，或从「添加应用」菜单、首页等「新建空白应用」入口进到同一个对话框时，名称下面多了一个勾选项「同时创建应用」，默认勾上；勾上时一次确定就同时建好软件包和同名应用，进到 Studio 左上角显示应用名；取消勾选就和以前一样只建软件包。
- 这是 Studio 重构专题的一步：去掉 Studio 首页以后，原来首页上一步建好包和应用的入口没了，这个勾选项把它补回到唯一的新建软件包对话框里。
- 如果应用的名字已被别的应用占用，什么都不会写入，对话框直接说明是哪个应用占用了，可以到「高级」里改命名空间或取消勾选；软件包建好但应用没能上线时会弹提示。只改界面，不改服务器和数据，可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **The create-package dialog offers 「同时创建应用」 / "Also create an app", ticked on every opening.** `PackageFormDialog` in create mode with a `newApp` step now draws the checkbox under the description in the Basics card. Ticked, it runs the step exactly as the Studio home's door did (#36748): reserve a free app name before any write (a taken one refuses the whole confirm, opens Advanced and writes nothing), `POST /api/v1/packages`, then the app's draft under the first-write pin and that one item's publish. Unticked, it posts the package alone, as before. A refused app after the package landed keeps the existing `appFailed` toast.
- **The dialog keeps its package face.** `newApp` used to reword the whole dialog for an app (title 「新建应用」, 「应用 ID」, the help rows). That face's only host, the Studio home, was removed by #36908, and the card puts the choice in the package dialog, so the rewording branch (`withAppDoorWording` and the `appDoor` ternaries) is removed. Success with an app now reads "Created package “NAME” and its app." (new key); a 409 and a generic failure read the package dialog's own lines.
- **Every door gets it.** `CreatePackageDialog` builds `newAppStep(client, locale)` and passes it; it is the only create-mode mount of `PackageFormDialog` in app-shell. Its doors: Setup → Packages' New Package button (both faces), the `?new=package` door that the console's 「新建空白应用」 entries open (#36908), and ResourceListPage's create-a-package-first prompt. `onCreated` still answers with the package id, so each door lands where it did: Setup's admin face in Studio on the new package (whose header then names the app), the development face on the list, the resource list on `./new?package=…`.
- **Strings:** `engine.packages.create.alsoApp`, `engine.packages.create.alsoAppHint` and `engine.packages.create.createdWithApp` in the studio catalogue (en, zh). Additive only; no key removed.
- Not touched: the server, and decision 5's fallback for app-less packages (#36899): an installed, older or unticked package still shows its package name in Studio's header.

## Tests

- `PackageFormDialog.newAppStep-36748.test.tsx` (the shared harness: real dialog, real `newAppStep`, real metadata client and `StudioDesignSurface` over a stateful fetch stub). New top-level describes, all mounting the real `CreatePackageDialog`:
  - the box is there and ticked on every opening, in en and zh (unticked, cancelled, reopened: ticked again);
  - ticked: `POST package` → `PUT app draft` → `POST app publish`, the app is the new package's, the toast, and Studio's header names the app;
  - unticked: only `POST /api/v1/packages`, no app or draft, the package toast, the header names the package;
  - ticked with both candidate app names taken: the refusal names the holding app, Advanced opens, nothing is written; unticking clears the refusal and the package alone goes through;
  - every door: a source read of app-shell finds `CreatePackageDialog` mounted exactly in `PackagesPage.tsx` and `ResourceListPage.tsx`, no other create-mode `PackageFormDialog`, and the wrapper passing `newAppStep(client, locale)`.
  - The #36748 cases survived #36908's move whole (three cases). Case 1 pinned the app-worded face this card removes; it now pins the package face with the box ticked, plus a CONTROL that a dialog without a step offers no box. Case 2's toast assertion reads the new success line; the rest of it (writes, header, back link) is unchanged.
- `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx`: the page's dialog stand-in now reports whether it was handed the step; three cases pin it for the admin face's button, the `?new=package` door and the development face's button.

<details><summary>Ablations — each one red, then restored by hash</summary>

Mutations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, on-disk counts printed), restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` and checked by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`. app-shell's tests import the dialog and the page by relative path, so no `dist/` is in the resolution path.

| # | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `appStep` always `undefined` (ticked creates no app) | 4: both "ticked" cases and both "taken" cases |
| A2 | `appStep` ignores the box | 2: "unticked" and the taken-then-untick case |
| A3 | the taken arm never fires | 2: both "taken" cases |
| A4 | the box resets to unticked on open | 8: every case that reads the default |
| A5 | `CreatePackageDialog` passes `newApp={undefined}` | 9: the three PackagesPage door cases, every `CreatePackageDialog` case, the wrapper source pin |
| A6 | ResourceListPage mounts `PackageFormDialog mode="create"` itself | 2: both door source pins |

A5's first attempt used an empty replacement, which the tool refused (nothing landed); it was re-run with `newApp={undefined}`. All six restore lines matched the HEAD blob.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's file surface names "the Studio package switcher" as a call site. It no longer exists: the top-bar switcher was removed by #36501 (`PackageSwitcher.tsx` now only exports a toast id), so there is no such door to wire. The doors that exist are listed above.
- The app-worded rows (`engine.studio.newApp.title`, `description`, `advancedHint`, `id`, `help.*`, `nsDerived`, `exists`, `failed`) have no reader after this change. They stay, because this card removes no released key; `nameTaken` and `appFailed` are still read. The en catalogue's comment says so. `check:i18n-dead-keys` is report-only.
- The submit button stays "Create package" with the box ticked; the checkbox and its hint say an app comes with it.
- A Studio-only author who cannot open Setup → Packages still has no New Package door (#36908's note); that is #37139's, not this card's.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm dev`, open Setup → Packages, New Package, type a name, keep 「同时创建应用」 ticked, Create. Expected: the toast "Created package “NAME” and its app.", then Studio on the new package with 「‹ Back to app · NAME」 in the header. Repeat unticked: the package toast, and the header shows the package name.

Read first: `PackageFormDialog.tsx` (the `appStep` line in `submit()` and the checkbox in the Basics card), `PackagesPage.tsx` (`CreatePackageDialog`), then the new describes at the end of `PackageFormDialog.newAppStep-36748.test.tsx`.

<details><summary>Local runs (head 97fa2d83)</summary>

All at head `97fa2d83` unless noted; exit codes captured before any pipe.

- vitest, `PackageFormDialog.newAppStep-36748`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 11 passed (11); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (src + `tsconfig.test.json`), after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure: lock VERDICT command-exit 0, 0 TS errors.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the six touched source files: exit 0 (warnings only, all pre-existing lines).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 172 passed, 2 skipped (174); Tests 5130 passed. The first run on `28a9d57a` failed `check-test-path-roots` on the new test (a local named `path` read as the fetch stub's URL path); fixed by the rename in `97fa2d83`.
- `check:test-source-alias` exit 0 · `check:i18n-keys` exit 0 · `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` VERDICT clean exit 0 (merges cleanly with main and #37315, which shares the two studio catalogues).
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 39 derived families, all run at `97fa2d83`, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every row carries its exit code).
